defs.def: affecting all or most people, places or things 全体的；普遍的；总的

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

ex.s: In the process of formalization, the concept can be expressed as a mathematical equation that can be applied generally.
ex.t: 要理解这一点，想象一张图，其中垂直线量化你可以购买多少张电影票。水平线量化你可以购买多少本犯罪小说。

ex.s: An opinion can be a general or individual view, belief or impression.
ex.t: 观点可以是一种普遍的或个人的看法、信念或印象。

ex.s: More generally, social instincts motivate us to learn how to behave in a socially complex world.
ex.t: 更普遍地说，社会本能促使我们学习如何在这个社会复杂的世界中行事。

defs.def: normal; usual 正常的；一般的；常规的

ex.s: In general, keep an eye on their property while they are gone.
ex.t: 一般而言，在他们不在时照看他们的财物。

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我开始了第二个抽屉，用来放更一般的发现：被发现的有几十种无名物种的新洞穴系统、在人体胃部发现的四百种细菌。

ex.s: She generally works with their regular teachers to get lessons and tests being used at their home schools.
ex.t: 伊丽莎白·西姆斯分析了五部伟大小说的最后章节，看看它们包含哪些要点以及如何将其改编用于你自己的作品。

ex.s: General knowledge can at times turn out to be true.
ex.t: 常识有时可能被证明是正确的。

ex.s: General Information about Group Play
ex.t: 关于团体游戏的通用信息

ex.s: Develop broad, general knowledge and experience.
ex.t: 发展广博的一般知识和经验。

ex.s: The general rule is that mild zones have relatively few languages.
ex.t: 一般规律是温带地区的语言相对较少。

ex.s: General facts about the book: Plot of the book: Comments: Conclusion and recommendation: Now write your book review.
ex.t: 关于这本书的一般信息：书的简介、书的情节、评论、结论和推荐。现在写你的书评。

ex.s: Meanwhile, with her parents' help, Moore is generally able to live a normal teenage life.
ex.t: 与此同时，在父母的帮助下，摩尔通常能够过上正常的青少年生活。

ex.s: The articles in magazines are generally short, which allows a child to finish reading a feature article without losing interest due to short attention span.
ex.t: 杂志上的文章一般都很短，这使得儿童可以完成一篇专题文章的阅读，而不会因为关注时间短而失去兴趣。

defs.def: including the most important aspects of sth; not exact or detailed 概括性的；大体的；笼统的
approximately, but not exactly, the direction/area mentioned 大致的，大概的（方向或地区）
not limited to a particular subject, use or activity 非专门的；一般性的；普通的

ex.s: When your boss or professor sends you out to do man-on-the-street interviews for a story, think about the topic and develop a list of about ten general questions relating to it.
ex.t: 当你的老板或教授派你出去为一篇报道做街头采访时，先想想主题，并就此列出大约十个相关问题。

defs.def: not limited to one part or aspect of a person or thing 整体的；全身的；全面的

ex.s: All of these factors could have a very negative effect on their general health.
ex.t: 所有这些因素都可能对它们的总体健康产生非常负面的影响。

ex.s: One reason is that although I’ve been working ever since leaving school, I won’t be voting in the next general election.
ex.t: 一个原因是，虽然我自从离开学校就一直在工作，但我不会在下次大选中投票。

ex.s: However, far less has been known about how meal timing and exercise might affect general health.
ex.t: 然而，关于进餐时间和运动如何影响整体健康，人们所知要少得多。

defs.def: highest in rank; chief 首席的；总管的

ex.s: When reading texts of several hundred words or more, learning is generally more successful when it’s on paper than onscreen.
ex.t: 阅读几百词或更长的文本时，在纸上学习通常比在屏幕上更成功。

ex.s: People in Thailand generally use their forks only to push food onto their spoons.
ex.t: 泰国人通常只用叉子把食物拨到勺子上。

ex.s: On public holidays, generally a Sunday timetable operates.
ex.t: 在公共假日，通常按周日时刻表运行。

ex.s: The traffic signals along Factoria Boulevard in Bellevue, Washington, generally don't flash the same length of green twice in a row, especially at rush hour.
ex.t: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤市Factoria大道上的交通信号，通常连续两次不会亮同样时长的绿灯，尤其在高峰时段。

ex.s: Some of today's AI pioneers want to move on from today's world of “weak” or “narrow” AI, to create “strong” or “full” AI, or what is often called artificial general intelligence（A GI）.
ex.t: 当今一些人工智能先驱想要摆脱“弱”或“窄”人工智能的当下，去创造“强”或“全”人工智能，即常被称为通用人工智能（AGI）的东西。

ex.s: Medium color choices are generally furniture pieces such as sofas, dinner tables or bookshelves    39   .
ex.t: 中等色彩选择通常是沙发、餐桌或书架等家具____39____。

ex.s: While high school does not generally encourage students to explore new aspects of life, college sets the stage for that exploration.
ex.t: 虽然高中通常不鼓励学生探索生活的新方面，但大学为这种探索搭建了舞台。

defs.def: as a whole 总的说来；从总体上看

ex.s: The results show that consumers generally trust negative reviews more than positive ones.
ex.t: 结果表明，消费者总体上更相信负面评论而不是正面评论。

ex.s: BMF’s general management.
ex.t: BMF的总体管理。

ex.s: Therefore, they can work for longer, consume more and in general be boost to the economy.
ex.t: 因此，他们可以工作更长时间，消费更多，总的来说对经济起到推动作用。
